purpose: Describe something just completed and still fresh.
keywords: Verb stem + たて; たての + noun
Would you like some freshly brewed tea?
When I had just arrived in Japan, I got lost every day.
formation: Verb stem + たて; たての + noun
restrictions: Most natural with actions whose fresh result matters, such as cooking or arriving.
mistake: Not all verbs take たて; たばかり has a wider range.
